title: Cold rebuild: static, dynamic or script?
summary: Classify programs with file and ldd before choosing a base image, from memory.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a skill stuck. In *Container base images* you found out what programs need at run time with `file` and
`ldd`. Now do it again from memory: the same programs, **no hints, no solution to peek at**. The checks are exactly
the ones you passed the first time.
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old commands feels like knowing
them; typing them cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.title: Static, dynamic or script? Cold
prompt: `~/bins` holds six programs. Write `~/answers/kinds.txt` (`NAME KIND`, sorted by name; KIND is `static`, `dynamic` or
`script`) and `~/answers/jq-libs.txt` (the shared libraries `jq` needs, without `linux-vdso.so.1` and the `ld-linux` loader).
From memory: no hints this time.
